name: LiPo battery 1S (3.7 V, with protection)
description: Single-cell lithium-polymer pouch, 3.7 V nominal (4.2 V full, 3.0 V empty), for pocket devices. Its voltage follows the state of charge and sags under load, and it drains (or charges) with the current that flows. + to a charger's B+ (TP4056 BAT) and − to its B−; the charger's OUT+ then feeds the board (Pico VSYS directly; XIAO / RP2040-Zero 5V through a slide switch and a Schottky diode). A 5 V Uno cannot run from it without a boost converter (boost-converter).

props.label: Capacity
props.description: Rated capacity. Pocket sizes: 150 mAh (402030), 500 mAh (503035), 1000 mAh (523450).

props.label: State of charge at start
props.description: Charge when the simulation starts (or now, when changed while running).

props.label: Protection circuit
props.description: Most cells have a small protection board (DW01) that disconnects the cell below about 2.5 V.

props.label: Drain speed-up (for tests)
props.description: Multiplies how fast charge is used or added, so a test can watch hours of discharge in seconds. 1 = real time. Anything else is NOT realistic and shows in the label.

footprint: Pouch cell with a protection board, 503035 for 500 mAh (5 × 30 × 35 mm), 2 wires (often a JST-PH 2.0 plug)
